ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, line $ {l}_{1}$ passes through points A($-2$, $0$) and B($0$, $2$), and line $ {l}_{2}: y=-4x+14$ intersects $ {l}_{1}$ at point C. Find the coordinates of point C.
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text: \textbf{Solution}: Since line $l_1$ intersects with line $l_2$ at point C, we have $\begin{cases}y=x+2\\ y=-4x+14\end{cases}$. Solving these equations yields $\begin{cases}x=\frac{12}{5}\\ y=\frac{22}{5}\end{cases}$. Therefore, the coordinates of point C are $\boxed{\left(\frac{12}{5}, \frac{22}{5}\right)}$.
